story.title: FWICEcondemns firing at Tiger Shroff; seeks security for actor
story.summary: The Federation of Western India Cine Employees (FWICE) on Sunday strongly condemned the firing incident involving Bollywood actor Tiger Shroff's vehicle and called for immediate security measures to ensure the safety of the actor and his family.

story.title: In 1943, a Christmas tree fire destroyed Bing Crosby’s 20-room mansion
story.summary: In January 1943, a fire caused by a Christmas tree ignited at Bing Crosby's Toluca Lake home. The family escaped unharmed, but they lost many treasured personal belongings in the blaze. Crosby subsequently moved his family to a new mansion in Holmby Hills after this incident. The estate changed owners several times and underwent restoration efforts over the years.
